# Consolidated third-party requirements for the `python-default` Pants resolve.
#
# This is hand-maintained rather than generated from src/*/pyproject.toml because those files
# also list intra-workspace packages (e.g. src/shared depends on "evaluation" and "interface").
# Pants' python_requirements() target has no notion of uv workspace members -- it would try to
# resolve "evaluation"/"interface" as real PyPI packages and fail. When you add/bump a dependency
# in a src/*/pyproject.toml, mirror the change here and run `pants generate-lockfiles`.
#
# Where a package appears with different floors across src/*/pyproject.toml files (e.g. polars
# >=1.13.1 in budget vs >=1.24.0 in evaluation), the entry here is intentionally the highest of
# the two -- a single shared resolve needs one version that satisfies every package's constraint.
